name: Weather
description: Current conditions and multi-day forecast using Open-Meteo (no API key). Ask for weather by city name.
author: ChatBridge

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather for a location (city name or place). Returns temperature, conditions, wind, and humidity.

location.description: City or place name, e.g. Austin, Tokyo, Paris France
